commands_used: answer 1. I serve the Toh-Reel-Ka, the Xeech-Leel secret order, as a Voh-Vastei. Hist trees are falling sick and the Unbound are draining sap, probably for a draught to kill the guardian of the Root. The Eye of Argonia, a Hist-amber jewel, could heal every tree if used at the Root. 2. Go to Gideon market and find the dealer selling an Eye of Argonia; Ovinius Calo is marked, and there is an Eye (Glass) here. 3. Talk to Ovinius Calo, persuade him or pay a few coins for the truth, and look at the Eye. 4. I do not know whether the Eye here is genuine (it says Glass), or who Ovinius Calo is; I can find out by talking to him.

answer 1. The Eye on the stall is cheap glass. Ovinius bought it from smugglers who kept the old silver setting, which may hold a clue to the real Eye. Unbound and a relic-hunter called the Collector also asked after it. 2. Go to Gideon South Watch, the leaning tower SE of the quay, and take the silver setting from the smugglers chest in the inner room. 3. Fight the smugglers, sneak past, pick the chest lock, or take the key from their boss. 4. I do not know who the Collector is or why the setting matters; I may learn by examining the setting.
use Door to South Watch Inner Room

answer 1. I got the old silver setting from the smugglers chest without a fight. The Collector, Ennodius Vanin, an Imperial relic-hunter, opened it first and left a note saying a ships name is scratched inside the band. 2. Take the setting to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom by the rootworm from the Gideon Hist garden. 3. Go straight to Nesh-Deeka, or first read the note and inspect the band for the ship name; I have not yet taken the note. 4. I do not know the ships name or why it matters, or what the Collector wants. I can read the note and ask Nesh-Deeka.

answer 1. The Eye in Gideon was glass. The setting it came in had the name Pale Harvest scratched inside, a Company freighter sunk in Hatandros Bight with a Gideon dealers whole stock aboard, so the real Eye may be in the wreck. Nesh-Deeka paid me 100 gold and returned the setting. The Unbound are also searching. 2. Nothing is assigned yet; the likely next step is the Pale Harvest wreck in Hatandros Bight, east coast south of Thorn, but I have no instruction. 3. Ask Nesh-Deeka for more, or go to the Bight. 4. I do not know how she knows about the Unbound ("we listen"), how to reach the wreck, or if the real Eye is aboard.

answer Notes: I am a Voh-Vastei of the Toh-Reel-Ka, working for Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. The Eye of Argonia for sale in Gideon (dealer Ovinius Calo) was cheap glass. I persuaded him to talk, and he said he bought it from smugglers at Gideon South Watch. I picked the chest there without a fight and took the old silver setting and the Collectors note. Ennodius Vanin, the Collector, is an Imperial relic-hunter who has hunted the Eye for twenty years. Inside the band is scratched "Pale Harvest", a Company freighter sunk in Hatandros Bight (east coast, south of Thorn) with a Gideon dealers whole stock aboard. Nesh-Deeka returned the setting and paid 100 gold, so I now carry the setting, the note, and roughly 300+ gold plus light armour. Unbound also hunted the glass Eye a month ago, and Nesh-Deeka says only "we listen". The next lead is the wreck of the Pale Harvest, and I do not yet know how to reach it or whether the real Eye is aboard.
